meta.source: Brainstorm 2026-11-17, direction C (black stage, product chapters). Product chapter colours copied exactly from the Bolo, Medioo, Finioo and IntelliDrugs design systems.

color.note: One theme on purpose: the site is a black stage. Its own chrome is black, white and greys; colour appears only inside a product chapter, in that product's own values.

tokens.name: stage
tokens.usage: Page ground: hero, client work, about, contact and the frame around every chapter.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised blocks on stage: client work cards, the contact panel.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Raised controls and the empty film frame before a poster loads.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers only (timeline rules, card hairlines). Never a control boundary.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Boundary of outlined buttons and the menu button (4.1:1 on stage).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the filled button on stage and surface (19:1 on stage).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Ledes, secondary text, nav links at rest (8.1:1 on stage, 7.0:1 on surface).

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Eyebrows, meta, stat captions, footer (5.8:1 on stage, 5.0:1 on surface). Never for a sentence the reader must act on.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on the filled ink button.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Text links and the focus ring on stage (6.9:1). Inside a chapter use that product's link token instead.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, 3px offset, on every focusable element on stage.

tokens.name: material
tokens.usage: The sticky nav with a 20px backdrop blur. Content scrolls under it. Solid fallback: surface.

tokens.name: bolo-sky-high
tokens.usage: Bolo chapter: top of the sky; chapter text sits here or on sky-mid.

tokens.name: bolo-sky-mid
tokens.usage: Bolo chapter: violet middle of the sky (on-scene text 8.0:1).

tokens.name: bolo-sky-low
tokens.usage: Bolo chapter: dusty-rose horizon. Behind the film only; never behind text (on-scene is 2.6:1 here).

tokens.name: bolo-sun
tokens.usage: Bolo chapter: the sun disc and its glow, and the film's play disc.

tokens.name: bolo-hill
tokens.usage: Bolo chapter: the near hill along the bottom edge of the chapter.

tokens.name: bolo-ink
tokens.usage: Bolo chapter: all text, on sky-high and sky-mid only.

tokens.name: bolo-link
tokens.usage: Bolo chapter: the 'Try Bolo' link (sun-ink at night).

tokens.name: medioo-ground
tokens.usage: Medioo chapter ground (Medioo's dark bg).

tokens.name: medioo-surface
tokens.usage: Medioo chapter: film frame fill and any card.

tokens.name: medioo-ink
tokens.usage: Medioo chapter: all text (15:1 on ground).

tokens.name: medioo-link
tokens.usage: Medioo chapter: links and the play disc ring (8.6:1 on ground).

tokens.name: medioo-oo
tokens.usage: Medioo chapter: the 'oo' of the wordmark only. Never text, never status.

tokens.name: medioo-dot
tokens.usage: Medioo chapter: the wordmark dot only.

tokens.name: finioo-ground
tokens.usage: Finioo chapter ground (Finioo's dark page).

tokens.name: finioo-surface
tokens.usage: Finioo chapter: film frame fill and the hero-figure card.

tokens.name: finioo-ink
tokens.usage: Finioo chapter: text and the hero figure.

tokens.name: finioo-ink-2
tokens.usage: Finioo chapter: ledes and figure units.

tokens.name: finioo-ember
tokens.usage: Finioo chapter: the one filled action (the play disc). Never text, never a thin line.

tokens.name: finioo-on-ember
tokens.usage: Glyph on finioo-ember.

tokens.name: intellidrugs-ground
tokens.usage: IntelliDrugs chapter ground (its dark bg).

tokens.name: intellidrugs-surface
tokens.usage: IntelliDrugs chapter: film frame fill.

tokens.name: intellidrugs-ink
tokens.usage: IntelliDrugs chapter: all text.

tokens.name: intellidrugs-link
tokens.usage: IntelliDrugs chapter: links, the wordmark full stop and the play disc.

tokens.name: intellidrugs-on-link
tokens.usage: Glyph on intellidrugs-link.

families.display: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "Inter", "Helvetica Neue", system-ui, sans-serif
families.text: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Inter", "Helvetica Neue", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: hero
styles.sample: I lead the team. And ship the whole product.
styles.usage: The one hero headline. Fluid: 48px at 390 wide, 96px from 1200 wide.

styles.name: section-title
styles.sample: Systems where the stakes were real.
styles.usage: Titles of stage sections (Client work, About, Contact). 34px on phones.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Proof figures in the stat row, tabular figures. 40px on phones.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.sample: Engineering Lead · Dhaka, UTC+6 · Open to remote
styles.usage: One line above the hero and above each section title, in ink-3. Sentence case.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Internet banking for 583,000 customers. A national regulator. And four products of my own.
styles.usage: Paragraph under a hero or section title, in ink-2. 19px on phones. Max 38ch.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: I write the failing test first, and keep the suite fast enough that nobody skips it.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Card meta, stat captions, role lines, footer. Never below 14px.

styles.name: bolo-title
styles.usage: Bolo chapter headline. English only is tracked; never track Bangla.

styles.name: medioo-title
styles.sample: Your mother's medical papers, in plain Bangla.
styles.usage: Medioo chapter headline (English). Its Bangla line uses medioo-bangla.

styles.name: medioo-bangla
styles.sample: আম্মার রিপোর্টে কী লেখা আছে, সহজ বাংলায়।
styles.usage: The Bangla line in the Medioo chapter. Line height stays at 1.6 for matras.

styles.name: finioo-figure
styles.usage: The one hero figure in the Finioo chapter, condensed (font-stretch 80%), tabular.

styles.name: intellidrugs-title
styles.sample: Bangladesh's drug data, checked by pharmacists.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. Large steps set the long, quiet rhythm between sections.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, pill gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a meta line and its title.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between tags; between buttons on phones.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Eyebrow to title; phone side gutter minimum.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Title to lede; card padding on phones; button to link.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; lede to buttons.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Text block to film; between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Gap between stage sections.

tokens.name: space-36
tokens.usage: Chapter padding (top and bottom) on desktop.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Desktop side gutter. Phones: max(20px, safe-area inset).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags and small chips on client work cards.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Client work cards and the contact panel.

tokens.name: radius-film
tokens.usage: The film frame on desktop. 20px on phones.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, the play disc, the nav menu button.

tokens.name: shadow-film
tokens.usage: The film frame: lifted off its chapter, with a light hairline edge.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards on stage: a hairline of light instead of a shadow, which black would swallow.

tokens.name: shadow-nav
tokens.usage: Bottom edge of the sticky nav material.

tokens.name: w-page
tokens.usage: Max width of stage content.

tokens.name: w-film
tokens.usage: Max width of a film frame.

tokens.name: h-nav
tokens.usage: Sticky nav height.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of every tappable control.

tokens.name: play-disc
tokens.usage: Play disc on the film, 60px on phones.
